_synthetic: hand-written 2026-10-01 — the status answer WITH its `config`, the part the recorded alertmanager_status.json scrubs. Modelled on what otel-mcp-server returned from a live Alertmanager 0.27.0 that day (`config` as the rendered text, every secret address printed as <secret>); every name, address and receiver here is invented.
_shape: Alertmanager API v2 GET /api/v2/status, wrapped as { version, uptime, cluster, config: <rendered configuration text> }
config:
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
  smtp_from: alertmanager@example.internal
  smtp_smarthost: maildev.example.internal:1025
  smtp_require_tls: false
route:
  receiver: oncall-webhook
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - severity
  continue: false
  routes:
  - receiver: traffic-ping
    match:
      alertname: NoTraffic
    continue: true
    repeat_interval: 5m
  - receiver: pager
    match:
      severity: critical
    continue: true
    repeat_interval: 1h
  - receiver: push-critical
    match:
      severity: critical
    continue: false
  - receiver: oncall-webhook
    match:
      severity: warning
    continue: false
    repeat_interval: 4h
  - receiver: chat
    match:
      severity: info
    continue: false
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
inhibit_rules:
- source_match:
    severity: critical
  target_match:
    severity: warning
  equal:
  - alertname
receivers:
- name: oncall-webhook
  webhook_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    url: <secret>
    url_file: ""
    max_alerts: 0
- name: pager
  email_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    to: oncall@example.internal
    from: alertmanager@example.internal
    headers:
      Subject: '{{ .GroupLabels.alertname }} - CRITICAL'
    html: '{{ template "email.default.html" . }}'
    require_tls: false
  webhook_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    url: <secret>
    max_alerts: 0
- name: push-critical
  webhook_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    url: <secret>
    max_alerts: 0
- name: traffic-ping
  webhook_configs:
  - send_resolved: false
    url: <secret>
    max_alerts: 0
- name: chat
  slack_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    api_url: <secret>
    channel: '#alerts'
templates: []
